name: Works In Progress (WIP) Paid Arts Internship
org: Dougherty Arts Center, City of Austin Arts, Culture, Music and Entertainment Department
what_you_do: Paid 8 week arts internship in person at the Dougherty Arts Center and the Zilker Hillside Theater. The page calls it a program for high school students.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 19 who live in Austin. Must be able to commit to the full internship. Acceptance depends on the City of Austin document check and New Employee Orientation.
pay_detail: Described as a paid internship. The hourly amount is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted. Join the Dougherty Arts Center mailing list for updates.
how_to_apply: No application is open now. Join the mailing list on the program page, or read the FAQ PDF. Questions go to the email link on the page.
notes: The age range on the page is 17 to 19. The page calls applicants high school students. It does not state pay, grades or a 2027 application window. Check when the mailing list announces 2027.
